objective: One sentence: what this initiative should achieve.
context: Background Mr. Go and Cursor need: baseline version, constraints, links to docs.
decisions: Decision already made that bounds the work
non_goals: Explicitly out of scope for this initiative
risks: Known risk or dependency to watch
qa_expectations: Regression bar for the initiative (e.g. unittest discover, focused module tests, manual QA).
next_action: What happens immediately after Mr. Go approves this packet.

approval.note: Set status to approved only after Mr. Go signs off. Do not mint tickets while pending.

tickets.title: Short outcome-oriented title
tickets.description: Scope: what to build, which files or surfaces, and any constraints.
tickets.non_goals: Per-slice exclusions (optional; merge into description when minting).
tickets.qa_expectation: e.g. tests.test_foo passes; full suite N/N
